speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Myeloid Leukemia). The blood smear showing immature cells with prominent nucleoli and needle-shaped inclusions is highly characteristic of Auer rods. These findings, combined with severe anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocytosis, confirm the diagnosis.
